cases.sentence: Захватив ковчег Бога, филистимляне принесли его из Эвен-Эзера в ___.
cases.translation: The Philistines took God's ark and brought it to Ashdod.
cases.explain: Motion into a location takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они подняли Дагона и вернули на ___.
cases.translation: They lifted up Dagon and set him in his place again.
cases.explain: The verb вернули (put back) takes the accusative case for the destination.

cases.sentence: Ни жрецы Дагона, ни входящие в его храм, не наступают на ___, где он лежал.
cases.translation: Neither the priests of Dagon nor those entering his temple step on the threshold.
cases.explain: The verb наступать (to step on) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь сурово наказал жителей Аждода и его окрестностей, наслав на них опустошение и поразив их ___.
cases.translation: The Lord heavily oppressed the people of Ashdod and its territory, afflicting them with tumors.
cases.explain: The verb поразив (striking/afflicting) takes the instrumental case here.

cases.sentence: Ковчег израильского бога не должен находиться здесь у ___.
cases.translation: The ark of the God of Israel should not stay here with us.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at, with) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они созвали всех филистимских правителей и спросили их, что нам делать с ковчегом израильского ___.
cases.translation: They called together all the lords of the Philistines and asked what to do with the ark of the God of Israel.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks possession: 'the God of Israel'.

cases.sentence: После того, как они переправили его в Гат, рука Господа обратилась и против этого ___.
cases.translation: After they moved it to Gath, the Lord's hand was against that city.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда ковчег Бога вносили в Экрон, жители кричали, «Ковчег Израильского Бога принесли к нам, чтобы погубить нас и наш ___!»
cases.translation: As God's ark was brought to Ekron, the people cried out that it was brought to kill them and their people.
cases.explain: The object of погубить (to kill/destroy) takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Захватив ковчег Бога, филистимляне принесли его из Эвен-Эзера в Аждот.
reading.question: Where did the Philistines take God's ark?
reading.explain: The Philistines took the ark from Ebenezer and brought it to Ashdod.

reading.ru: Затем они внесли ковчег в храм Дагона и поставили около Дагона.
reading.question: What did the Philistines do with the ark of God?
options: Brought it into the temple of Dagon and set it by Dagon
reading.correct: Brought it into the temple of Dagon and set it by Dagon
reading.explain: They brought it into Dagon's house and placed it by Dagon.

reading.ru: Когда жители Аждода встали на другой день рано утром, Дагон, упавший лицом на землю, лежал перед ковчегом Господа.
reading.question: What happened to Dagon when the people of Ashdod woke up?
options: Dagon had fallen on his face before the ark
reading.correct: Dagon had fallen on his face before the ark
reading.explain: Dagon had fallen face down on the ground before the Lord's ark.

reading.ru: Его голова и руки были отломаны и валялись на пороге, целым осталось лишь туловище.
reading.question: What happened to Dagon's body on the next day?
options: His head and hands were broken off; only his torso remained
He was moved to another temple
reading.correct: His head and hands were broken off; only his torso remained
reading.explain: His head and both hands were severed and lay on the threshold; only his torso was left intact.

reading.ru: Господь сурово наказал жителей Аждода и его окрестностей, наслав на них опустошение и поразив их наростами.
reading.question: How did the Lord punish the people of Ashdod?
reading.explain: The Lord struck the people of Ashdod and its region with tumors.

reading.ru: Смерть наполнила тот город ужасом, и вопль города доходил до небес.
reading.question: What was the condition of the city of Ekron when the ark arrived?
options: Death and panic filled the city and their cry reached heaven
The city rejoiced at the ark's arrival
Peace and prosperity came to the city
reading.correct: Death and panic filled the city and their cry reached heaven
reading.explain: Death filled the city with panic and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
